title: Text: DET R.J. Burgess ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Can you send me your email address again
Who did you like on Day 2

From our draft? Everybody...I freakin love our draft this year I saw Wolf (LHP from Louisville) and Deatherage (OF Nc St) both at FSU...Wolf is projectable LHS w/ avg arm strength and the makings of 2 average breaking balls. Good big ML type build (6’6) and feel to pitch. Our scout there Harold Zonder has good feel for arms...signed Chad Green out of Louisville Deatherage is really nice senior sign, most senior signs don’t have loud tools like this guy...easy double plus runner and athletic with power...14 homers this year which is a good number in college baseball. Our area scout Taylor Black actually coached at NCST for a couple years before he started scouting, so he has better feel for this guys makeup than anyone...and he’s on the makeup
The other guys I haven’t seen myself but the tools and athleticism are really interesting...haven’t added this many “upside” and “hi ceiling” guys in a while
Without question...day 3 is area guy territory
I have to get back to you later with an answer
